name: rooftop-chiller-requirements

fields.TITLE: Rooftop chiller 5-2000 product requirements specification
DESCRIPTION: Product requirements specification for the modular rooftop chiller platform (5 to 2000 kW class).
Covers performance, reliability and safety, and installation, service and compliance for commercial building applications.
Basis for design, validation planning and the release of the engineering BOM.
fields.FILE_DESCRIPTION_1: Market and customer needs for the rooftop segment
fields.FILE_DESCRIPTION_2: Rating conditions for air conditioners and liquid chilling packages
fields.FILE_DESCRIPTION_3: Regulatory checklist for refrigerant and pressure equipment
fields.FILE_DESCRIPTION_4: Capacity, efficiency and sound benchmark of three competitors
fields.FILE_DESCRIPTION_5: Service findings from the previous generation

topLevel.DESCRIPTION: Top level requirement of the rooftop chiller platform: the complete set of customer, performance, safety and service needs.
topLevel.COMMENTS: Root of the requirements structure. Connected to the product record.

decisions.DECISION: Use R-32 as the primary refrigerant
decisions.RATIONALE: Lower global warming potential than R-410A and compatible with the planned F-gas phase-down; costs for A2L safety measures accepted.
Matches customer tender documents and allows Eurovent certification.
Competitor benchmark shows 80 dB(A); a lower value is a differentiator for rooftop sites near offices.

fields.DESCRIPTION: Thermal and acoustic performance the chiller must deliver at rated conditions.
fields.COMMENTS: Level 1 group for everything that is measured on the test bench.
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: Efficiency and sound pull in different directions.
fields.DIFFICULTY_COMMENTS: Needs coordinated fan and heat exchanger design.

children.title: Cooling capacity

fields.DESCRIPTION: The chiller delivers 500 kW cooling capacity at 35 degrees C ambient air and 7 degrees C leaving water temperature.
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: Capacity drops at high ambient; derating curve needed.
fields.TEST_PROCEDURE: Operate the chiller at full load on the climate test bench at EN 14511 conditions and record cooling output for 60 minutes.
fields.EXPECTED_RESULT: Measured capacity is at or above the rated value.
fields.SUCCESS_CRITERIA: Capacity of at least 495 kW (minus 1 percent) averaged over the last 30 minutes.
fields.DEPENDENT_REQUIREMENTS_COMMENTS: Efficiency is only meaningful at rated capacity.
fields.REMARKS_IMAGE_1: Design derating curve from the simulation.

children.implementedByNote: Heat exchanger and fan unit drive the capacity

children.title: Energy efficiency

fields.DESCRIPTION: The chiller reaches an energy efficiency ratio (EER) of at least 3.4 at rated conditions and an ESEER of at least 4.6.
fields.COMMENTS: Needed for the top energy class in tenders.
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: Prototype showed 3.1 in the first test.
fields.DIFFICULTY_COMMENTS: Requires variable speed fans and an electronic expansion valve.
fields.TEST_PROCEDURE: Measure electrical input power and cooling output at full load and at 75, 50 and 25 percent part load, then calculate EER and ESEER.
fields.EXPECTED_RESULT: EER and ESEER meet or exceed the specified values.
fields.SUCCESS_CRITERIA: EER at least 3.4 and ESEER at least 4.6, each with a measurement uncertainty below 3 percent.
fields.DEPENDENT_REQUIREMENTS_COMMENTS: Efficiency is measured at the rated capacity.
fields.CONFLICTING_REQUIREMENTS_COMMENTS: Higher fan speed improves efficiency but raises the sound level.
fields.REMARKS_IMAGE_1: Gap between the first prototype and the target.

children.implementedByNote: Heat exchanger bundle sets the approach temperature

children.title: Sound power level

fields.DESCRIPTION: The sound pressure level at 10 m free field distance does not exceed 78 dB(A) at full load.
fields.COMMENTS: Rooftop sites close to office space need quiet units.
fields.PRIORITY_COMMENTS: Differentiator against the benchmark at 80 dB(A).
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: Fan tonal noise is hard to predict.
fields.DIFFICULTY_COMMENTS: Fan blade design and vibration isolation.
fields.TEST_PROCEDURE: Measure sound pressure at 10 m according to ISO 3744 with the unit at full load and at night mode.
fields.EXPECTED_RESULT: Sound pressure stays below the limit in all operating modes.
fields.SUCCESS_CRITERIA: At most 78 dB(A) at full load and 72 dB(A) in night mode.
fields.CONFLICTING_REQUIREMENTS_COMMENTS: Quiet fan operation limits airflow and therefore efficiency.

children.implementedByNote: Vibration absorber and fan unit decide the noise level

fields.DESCRIPTION: Requirements that keep people safe and the chiller running for its service life.
fields.COMMENTS: Level 1 group for safety and lifetime requirements.
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: A2L refrigerant adds ignition risk handling.
fields.DIFFICULTY_COMMENTS: Needs coordinated mechanical and control measures.

fields.DESCRIPTION: The refrigerant circuit is leak tight and protected against overpressure.
fields.COMMENTS: Group of the safety requirements for the refrigerant circuit.

children.title: Leak tightness

fields.DESCRIPTION: The sealed refrigerant circuit loses less than 3 g of R-32 per year.
fields.COMMENTS: Required for the F-gas leak check interval.
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: Brazed joints are the main leak risk.
fields.DIFFICULTY_COMMENTS: Joint design and brazing process control.
fields.TEST_PROCEDURE: Charge the circuit and test all joints with a helium sniffer, then run a pressure decay test for 24 hours.
fields.EXPECTED_RESULT: No detectable leakage at any joint.
fields.SUCCESS_CRITERIA: Leak rate below 3 g/year and no pressure decay above 0.5 percent.
fields.DEPENDENT_REQUIREMENTS_COMMENTS: Pressure relief components add joints that must be leak tested.

children.implementedByNote: Pipe spool and manifold assemblies carry the brazed joints

children.title: Pressure relief protection

fields.DESCRIPTION: Pressure relief devices open before the maximum allowable pressure of 42 bar is exceeded.
fields.COMMENTS: Category II equipment under the Pressure Equipment Directive.
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: Wrong set pressure is a certification finding.
fields.DIFFICULTY_COMMENTS: Standard certified relief valves are available.
fields.TEST_PROCEDURE: Raise the high side pressure with the compressor blocked and record the opening pressure of the relief valve.
fields.EXPECTED_RESULT: The valve opens at its set pressure and reseats.
fields.SUCCESS_CRITERIA: Opening pressure between 41 and 42 bar, reseat pressure above 36 bar.

children.implementedByNote: Valve assembly provides the relief function

children.title: Service life

fields.DESCRIPTION: The chiller reaches a design service life of 15 years with scheduled maintenance.
fields.COMMENTS: Commercial buildings expect a long asset life.
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: Coastal sites increase the corrosion risk.
fields.DIFFICULTY_COMMENTS: Needs coated coils and a robust frame.
fields.TEST_PROCEDURE: Run an accelerated life test with 2000 hours of thermal cycling, salt spray exposure and vibration.
fields.EXPECTED_RESULT: No functional failure or structural damage after the test.
fields.SUCCESS_CRITERIA: No leaks, no cracked welds and performance within 3 percent of the initial values.
fields.REMARKS_IMAGE_1: Strain exceeded the limit after 1500 hours.

children.implementedByNote: Supporting framework and cross members carry the life load

fields.DESCRIPTION: Needs of the installers, service technicians and approval bodies.
fields.COMMENTS: Level 1 group for the lifecycle and regulatory requirements.
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: Mostly known practice from earlier generations.

children.title: Installation and commissioning

fields.DESCRIPTION: Two technicians can install and commission the chiller on a roof within one working day.
fields.COMMENTS: Based on the field feedback of the previous generation.
fields.DIFFICULTY_COMMENTS: Lifting points and quick connectors are standard parts.
fields.TEST_PROCEDURE: Install a pre-series unit with two technicians following the installation manual and time the work.
fields.EXPECTED_RESULT: Installation and commissioning finish within one shift.
fields.SUCCESS_CRITERIA: Total time below 8 hours including functional test.

children.implementedByNote: The exchanger module defines the lifting and connection points

fields.DESCRIPTION: The chiller carries the CE mark and complies with the F-gas regulation, the Pressure Equipment Directive and the Ecodesign requirements.
fields.COMMENTS: Conformity assessment is run by regulatory affairs.
fields.RISK_COMMENTS: Notified body lead time can delay the launch.
fields.TEST_PROCEDURE: Review the technical file against the checklist of all applicable directives.
fields.SUCCESS_CRITERIA: Declaration of conformity is signed and the technical file is complete.
fields.DEPENDENT_REQUIREMENTS_COMMENTS: Safety evidence is part of the technical file.

fields.TITLE: Release of performance requirements
fields.DESCRIPTION: Approval of the performance requirement group (capacity, efficiency, sound level) as the basis for detailed design.
fields.REMARKS: Targets are aligned with the competitor benchmark.

fields.TITLE: Release of reliability and safety requirements
fields.DESCRIPTION: Approval of the safety and service life requirements including the customer review.
fields.REMARKS: Safety requirements reviewed with the notified body.
